title: Reason Code 23 — error during EAP processing (usually the NPS certificate)
plain_english: NPS hit an internal error while running EAP. The official text says 'check EAP log files', but in the field this is almost always a problem with the NPS server's OWN certificate — expired, missing its private key, or not meeting 802.1X requirements — rather than anything the client did.

any: during the Network Policy Server use of the Extensible Authentication Protocol

causes.cause: The NPS server certificate expired or its private key is missing (typical after an export/import that dropped the key).
causes.next_check: On the NPS server, open certlm.msc → Personal: confirm a valid certificate with the Server Authentication EKU and the key icon (private key present).

causes.cause: The certificate was renewed but the network policy still points at the old one.
causes.next_check: Open the network policy's PEAP/EAP-TLS settings and reselect the current certificate, then save — NPS does not always follow renewals automatically.

causes.cause: Revocation checking fails — NPS can't reach the CRL/OCSP endpoint for its certificate chain.
causes.next_check: Check the CAPI2 operational event log on the NPS server and test CRL URL reachability from that box.
